title: Context Management
subtitle: Monitor LLM context composition, capture snapshots, manage entity injection

monitor.readyDesc: Click below to arm. The system will capture the full context on the next LLM call
monitor.waitingDesc: Armed. Waiting for the next LLM call to auto-capture
monitor.continuousDesc: When enabled, every LLM call is captured and appended as a compact record (debug use; watch performance). External tools can poll GET /api/context/snapshot/records.

history.prefixUnchangedDesc: Captured message prefix unchanged. Tool schemas, provider adaptation and cache service state are outside this comparison; the cause of a lower hit rate remains unknown.

legalBreakDesc.fold: Conversation fold just rewrote the summary prefix — low hit on the first post-fold round is expected and self-recovers next round
legalBreakDesc.compress: Context compaction just rewrote the prefix — low hit on the first post-compaction round is expected and self-recovers next round
legalBreakDesc.refold: Direction-change fold just rewrote the history segment in place — low hit on the first post-fold round is expected and self-recovers next round

providers.noContent: Nothing injected yet (full content appears here after injection)

sections.title: Context Layers
sections.volatilityTitle: Volatility {{value}} (higher = changes more often, placed later)
sections.cachedPrefixRegion: {{count}} cached prefix messages (byte-identical to last capture, click to expand)
sections.breakDesc: ~{{tokens}}t before this point are cacheable this round; content after is rewritten
sections.breakBanner: Prefix break: {{label}} message #{{index}} (0-based) — ~{{tokens}}t cacheable before, rewritten after
sections.stableAll: Byte-identical to last capture: prefix fully stable (low hit rate ⇒ provider-side variance)

cache.title: Cache Insights
cache.unobservable: This response from {{model}} has no cache fields. Its hit rate is unknown, not zero.

window.title: Context window
window.description: Estimated input in sending order. Select a layer to inspect its stability; the blank area is remaining capacity, not a cache hit forecast.
window.pressure: The input is approaching the model limit. Reserve room for tool results and the reply.

diagnostics.description: Read-only message excerpts and execution facts from memory. No model calls or history database reads. Overlapping step durations do not add up to wall time.
diagnostics.retention: Up to {{count}} runs · cleared on restart
diagnostics.wallTime: Elapsed wall time for this run
diagnostics.cold: This conversation window is not loaded or has been evicted. No database fallback.
diagnostics.modelNote: Generated text is not proof of delivery. First output wait includes networking, queuing and model processing. Unknown cache data is not a cache miss.
diagnostics.excerptNote: Only redacted excerpts are retained. Delivery status comes from receipts; missing means unobserved.
diagnostics.evicted: This record was evicted or the process restarted.
